trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
Cell (1,6) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
I can't rule out left or down yet, so I'll make an educated guess: left.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going left, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (2,3); going down would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order). So my guess (left from cell (1,5)) was wrong, so the line must go down.
Cell (3,5) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes down.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
I can't rule out left or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: left.
Cell (4,3) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Going up, the next 9 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (2,4); going left, the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,2). So the line goes down.
Going left would leave both cell (4,1) and cell (6,1) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going down leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes right.
Cell (4,3) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes up.
Going up, the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,1); going right leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes left.
The line must go up: left is number 6, which comes later.
Cell (1,1) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Cell (1,3) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes right.
Cell (6,6) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes down.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
